
{{alias}}( x )
    Evaluates the identity function for a 64-bit signed integer `x`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: Int64
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: Int64
        Input value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/number/int64/ctor}}( 1 ) )
    <Int64>[ 1n ]
    > y = {{alias}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/number/int64/ctor}}( 0 ) )
    <Int64>[ 0n ]
    > y = {{alias}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/number/int64/ctor}}( 4294967296 ) )
    <Int64>[ 4294967296n ]
    > y = {{alias}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/number/int64/ctor}}( -1000000000000 ) )
    <Int64>[ -1000000000000n ]

    See Also
    --------
